ex_long: ^Ann: The new rota starts on Monday, and every team takes one week of the kitchen.
^Bob: That means our team has the first week, which is the week of the big audit.
^Ann: I asked facilities to move us, but they said the list was already printed.
^Bob: Then we should ask the audit team to bring their own mugs for the whole week.
^Ann: They will not like that, but at least the sink will not fill up by lunchtime.
^Bob: Who has the second week? I hope it is the team on the third floor this time.
^Ann: It is the help desk, and they have asked for the week after the audit as well.
^Bob: Then nobody will want the third week, since that is the week of the office move.
^Ann: Facilities said the move might slip, so the third week may not be so bad after all.
^Bob: Let us put our names down now, before somebody else takes the easy week from us.
